Agent One Finance · FOBO live run · 07 Oct 2026

Your FOBO skill, run end to end on MB Rec's breaks

This is a real run on the dev stack, not a mock-up. An MB Rec end-of-day event for PRIME-MB-11, COB 06 Oct opened a case. The platform read MB Rec's breaks, looked up each book in the reference map, and applied your FOBO Investigation Skill v1.0. It stopped for the controller, asked the model only about the judgement calls, and recorded Frank's sign-off. The next day's event then re-tested yesterday's decisions. The data systems and the model are the dev stand-ins (stubs). The flow, rules, gates and audit are the real ones.

1. What happens, step by step

  1. MB RecEnd-of-day run finishes for PRIME-MB-11, COB 06 Oct and posts an eventPOST /api/events
  2. loadReads MB Rec's open breaks: 7 rows. No re-matching of CATS to MOTIFmbrec.breaks
  3. enrichJoins the dated FO/BO snapshot per instrument: cut-offs, curves, components, versionsmotif.break_snapshots
  4. resolveLooks up the book in the reference map, as of the COB: book → desk → escalation teamfobo-reference graph
  5. classifyYour skill as configuration: R5, §8 scenarios, timing, C1–C6, tests FO-1…8 and BO-1…6, FO-6 findings, verdict table, R2, P1playbook
  6. tollgateFrank checks the breaks and classification and adds what the desk said, before any model callcontroller
  7. reasonModel investigates only the judgement groups, with booking events and trade-level data, through the gatewaymotif.booking_events · cats.trades · motif.trades
  8. reviewFrank signs off: P1 confirmations, §14 checklist, asks the desk (§13), comments on escalationscontroller
  9. recordTickets for DO_NOT_POST and escalations; decisions become priors for the next 180 daysticketing.create_ticket
  10. next COBThe next run re-tests yesterday's POST and MONITOR verdicts (§11 end state)follow-through

2. How it gets data from MB Rec and the reference map

MB Rec (the breaks). MB Rec has already reconciled CATS to MOTIF. The platform never re-matches. When MB Rec finishes a book it calls POST /api/events with the book and COB (signed with the event secret). The case opens as the scheduler service account. Its first step calls MB Rec's breaks tool with {book, cob}. In the office this is MB Rec's MCP server, configured in connectors.yaml (URL, auth header from the environment, and scope: book so a user only sees their books). MOTIF's break_snapshots is joined on instrument. The field list is in fobo-skill/mbrec-data-contract.md. A missing field makes a test "not run", never a pass.
The reference map (who owns it). config/agent-one-finance/knowledge/fobo-reference.yaml is a dated graph: book → belongs_to → desk → escalates_to → team. The resolve step reads it as of the COB, so a book that moved desk on 1 Jul resolves to the old desk for June COBs. Every PRIME-MB-11 break resolved to APAC-CASH → Operations. The category's own owner (CATS support, Technology and so on) decides where each ticket goes.

Every check and test still runs and is kept on the break, including negatives and "not run because the threshold is unset" (P1). The first positive check is the cause. R2 turns any POST on a front-office cause into ESCALATE. The verdict table settles deterministic categories. Judgement categories go to the model, and every verdict then goes to a person.

5. The other run: R5 held a whole book

PRIME-MB-06's event arrived while MB Rec still showed the book as In Progress. Your R5 check put both breaks in category W (books not complete), with verdict ESCALATE. Nothing is investigated or posted until MB Rec marks the book Complete.

6. Next COB: the end state is re-tested (§11)

MB Rec's event for 07 Oct opened the next case. It holds two breaks: IRS 5Y USD (MISSING_SIDE), JGB 10Y (TIMING). UST 2Y, posted on 06 Oct, is no longer reported by MB Rec, so the 06 Oct case now shows it as cleared. An adjustment that did not clear would come back as category U (ESCALATE). A MONITOR that did not clear would come back as K.

7. The screens Frank used

8. What is different in the office

  • MB Rec, MOTIF, CATS and ticketing become the office MCP servers in connectors.yaml. The group file does not change if the tool names match, and only args and field names change if they don't.
  • The event: MB Rec (or its scheduler) calls POST /api/events with the X-AOF-Event-Secret header when each book's end-of-day run is complete. Breaks MB Rec adds later open a follow-up case linked to the day's case.
  • The model: Agent One's Agent SDK wrapper is plugged in as the LLM adapter (AOF_LLM_ADAPTER). It sees only the judgement groups and only the tools listed in the group file.
  • People: controllers sign in through SSO, and roles come from the entitlement service (FOBO_CONTROLLER, PRIME_DESK and so on).
  • Parity: before go-live, scripts/fobo_aof_parity.py proves the category, side and verdict match the old FOBO run for every break.
